title: Localized Hom comparison for shifted functorial resolutions
statement: On a small ringed site (C,J,R), let K be its cochain-complex category [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], Q:K → D(R) the derived localization [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and H its Hom-complex bifunctor [def-pur-hom-complex]. Given a functor I:K → K and natural transformation eta:id → I such that each eta_M is a quasi-isomorphism [def-pc-quasi-iso-modules] and I(M) is K-injective [def-pur-kinjective-complex], for every integer n there is a natural isomorphism (id × (I followed by shift(n))) followed by H and Q to (id × (shift(n) followed by I)) followed by H and Q.

source.place: Lemma 0A95 and Sections 21.34--21.35 (Tags 0A8X and 08JA); functorial resolution comparison

proof.text: Put S=shift(n). The natural transformations alpha=eta_(I(M)[n]) and beta=I(eta_M[n]) give the zigzag I(M)[n] → I(I(M)[n]) ← I(M[n]). Alpha is a quasi-isomorphism by assumption; beta is one because eta_(M[n]) followed by beta equals eta_M[n] followed by eta_(I(M)[n]), and two-out-of-three applies. Mathlib supplies preservation of quasi-isomorphisms and K-injectivity under shifts.

All three vertices are K-injective. Apply quasiIso_homComplex_map to each arrow and the identity on L. DerivedCategory.Q inverts the resulting quasi-isomorphisms; NatTrans.isIso_iff_isIso_app makes both whiskered natural transformations isomorphisms. Compose asIso(alpha) with asIso(beta).symm.

lean.statement:
theorem homComplex_resolution_shift_comparison
    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C]
    (J : GrothendieckTopology C) (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u}
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj R))]
    (I : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u}
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj R)) ℤ ⥤
      CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u}
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj R)) ℤ)
    (η : 𝟭 _ ⟶ I)
    (hI : ∀ M, QuasiIso (η.app M) ∧ (I.obj M).IsKInjective) (n : ℤ) :
    Nonempty (
      (𝟭 _).prod (I ⋙ shiftFunctor _ n) ⋙
        Functor.uncurry.obj (homComplexFunctor (C := C) (J := J) (R := R)) ⋙
          DerivedCategory.Q ≅
      (𝟭 _).prod (shiftFunctor _ n ⋙ I) ⋙
        Functor.uncurry.obj (homComplexFunctor (C := C) (J := J) (R := R)) ⋙
          DerivedCategory.Q)
